name: bonewright
description: Rig and animate Blender characters from Codex: Python drives the steps, codex exec judges, gates verify.

interface.shortDescription: Rig a character mesh with Rigify and verify it, from Codex
interface.longDescription: Runs the bonewright CLI (bw) against a Blender install: analyses the mesh, asks Codex for metarig bone targets, generates a Rigify rig, checks weights and symmetry with deterministic gates, renders test views, and lets Codex judge them. Text-to-motion via kimodo.cpp and BVH import are included; retargeting comes in v0.2.
defaultPrompt: Rig this character mesh with bonewright and show me the report.
Check bonewright doctor and tell me what is missing.
Generate a walking motion with bonewright and import it into Blender.
